hook_anchors.why: A cool, confident response to a shocked stranger establishes an immediate power dynamic.
Guards defying a direct order to arrest an imposter creates instant dramatic tension.

hook_anchors.excerpt: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
hook_anchors.why: The shocking revelation that a supposed dead man has returned to claim his title.

hook_anchors.excerpt: This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!
hook_anchors.why: The mother publicly proclaiming her returned son as the true duke changes the entire power structure.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Why do the guards refuse to arrest him?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: Because we know who he is.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Leaves the audience wondering what the guards know that the villain does not.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: How will Alexander exact his revenge on Rupert?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Ends the episode right on the precipice of a violent or dramatic reckoning between rivals.
